verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents multi-repo analysis: linked repositories let it detect breaking changes, API mismatches and dependency issues across repository boundaries during review. It also documents presenting large diffs as logical cohorts and layers, with range-specific summaries and diagrams showing how changes fit together. That covers both halves of the story at the core level. Missing for 10: explicit monorepo-scale handling beyond large-diff presentation, in-depth docs on how cross-repo context is assembled and its limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-repo review quality.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, the reviewer understands changes that span multiple repositories or a large monorepo and reviews them coherently

citations.quote: Link related repositories so CodeRabbit can detect breaking changes, API mismatches, and dependency issues that cross repository boundaries during code review.
Understand large diffs as logical cohorts and layers, with range-specific summaries and diagrams that show how each change fits together.
